text:
Maria G: quick warm handoff — I'm heading offline in ~15m. leaving primary to Kevin for the night shift. current context: incident 4721 (high token-latency on us-west-2 hosted API) is under mitigation; CI still seeing elevated p95 for generation routes.

oncall-bot: [ALERT] INCIDENT 4721 | HIGH_LATENCY | detected 2026-11-02T03:42:11Z | severity: P1 | affected: hosted/text.generate (us-west-2) | pager: primary oncall

Kevin T: got it. I'm taking primary. quick Q: what's the current mitigation state and any manual steps pending? should I page eng-sre if latency doesn't drop below 600ms p95 in next 10m?

Maria G: mitigation in progress — routing to fallback model variant + prefix cache clear on the hot pool. manual steps left: 1) confirm fallback routing is stable, 2) roll small canary to dedicated pool if spike continues.

Sophie D: runbooks linked below: most relevant are: runbook/inference/latency-spike and runbook/oncall/pager-escalation. if you need quick commands:

```
# check routing table for model variants
redwoodctl routing list --region us-west-2 --service text.generate
# clear prefix cache for pool-a
redwoodctl cache clear --pool pool-a --prefix "user:" --confirm
```

Lee R: paging rules recap (from runbook):
- pager primary for any P1 or customer-visible P0/P1 impact.
- escalate to eng-sre if mitigation not showing improvement after 2x the SLO window (so if p95 stays > target after 10m) OR if error rates increase > 3x baseline.
- page infra-oncall for hardware or region-level capacity issues (e.g., OOMs, node flapping).

Kevin T: ok. so I should page eng-sre at ~03:52Z if no improvement. I'll watch. who's secondary for this shift?

Maria G: secondary is Lee R until 06:00Z, then AJ takes over for the late overlap. there's a coverage gap around 05:30-05:45Z where no one from PM sits in the desk — I left a note for on-call swap to cover that window.

AJ: noted. I'll be reachable and can take a hot swap if needed. if we need escalation to customers, who owns comms?

Sophie D: customer comms: product-ops owns status page updates for hosted incidents. escalation path: primary -> product-ops -> legal if customer contract mentions regulatory SLA. use the template in runbook/communications/status-update-template.

Kevin T: heading into mitigation now. first action: confirm fallback routing stability, then monitor p95 for 10m. I'll post updates here.

oncall-bot: [ACTION] assigned incident-4721 to Kevin T (primary) and Lee R (secondary) at 2026-11-02T03:44:00Z

Kevin T: update 03:48Z — fallback routing applied, initial checks show drop from ~1.2s -> ~720ms p95. still above our target (500ms). watching next 10m.

Lee R: I'll stand by. if no further improvement by 03:58Z I can trigger canary shift to dedicated pool (manual have to coordinate with infra).

Maria G: two quick pointers before I go: 1) check the routing logs for stray long requests (search for seq>4096), 2) if you hit the autoscaler lock, don't force scale without paging infra.

Kevin T: copy. also leaving a short runbook excerpt for escalation thresholds so it's easy to find:

```
Escalation matrix (quick):
- P1 (customer-visible latency/error): page primary immediately
- After 10m no improvement (p95 > target or error rate >3x): page eng-sre
- After 20m no improvement: page infra and engineering manager on duty
- If customer SLA at risk -> notify product-ops and legal
```

AJ: FYI — I'm available via phone if you want me to take traffic or handle comms. phone: +1-555-0199.

Kevin T: 04:02Z — p95 is holding at ~540-600ms, request rate steady. will keep monitoring. no customer-reported incidents yet. posting any customer-facing updates only if product-ops confirms.

Sophie D: thumbs to the checklist. if you need escalation templates: https://internal/redwood/runbooks/communications/status-update-template :thumbsup:

Maria G: thanks team — leaving context in ticket INC-4721. Kevin, call me if things regress. I'm OOO after 04:10Z. :wave:

Kevin T: thanks Maria. I'll keep the thread updated and page per the matrix.

Lee R: I'll be standby and ready to escalate at 03:58Z if needed.

oncall-bot: [RESOLVE] INCIDENT 4721 -> mitigation stable at 2026-11-02T04:19:05Z | final note: fell back to baseline after dedicated canary increase; owner: Kevin T

Kevin T: resolved. final notes added to INC-4721: root cause suspected routing pressure + single model variant kernel hot path; follow-up action: model churn + autoscaler tuning backlog ticket. closing handoff. :white_check_mark:
